title: indigo_test: INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER with the parallel case runner reports every non-matching case as FAIL
description:
Found in review of ticket 3002bd75 (2026-11-17). Running indigo_test/build/integration/test_agent_scheduler with INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER set (e.g. INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER=running_) runs the matching cases correctly, but every case that does not match is reported as FAIL and the process exits 1, so a filtered run cannot pass.

Likely cause (source inspection, to confirm): test_agent_scheduler.c uses indigo_test/integration/parallel_case_runner.h with its own filter (argv[1] or SCHEDULER_TEST_FILTER, see main() at the end of the file). Each forked child apparently still applies the generic INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER of indigo_test/test_runner.h (indigo_run_tests), which returns INDIGO_TEST_SKIP (77) with "SKIP ...: no test cases matched the filter" for a non-matching case; parallel_case_runner.h counts any nonzero child exit status as a failure (~line 289).

Expected: INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER selects cases in the parallel runner like in other suites (non-matching cases are not run and not counted), or a child exit 77 is counted as skipped, not failed; a run whose selected cases all pass exits 0, and a filter matching nothing does not report success. Check the other users of parallel_case_runner.h (test_dome_nexdome3_simulator.c, test_system_alpaca_omnisim.c, test_system_alpaca_simulator.c) and tools/run_driver_test.py / the recording contract (indigo_test/AGENTS.md, test_harness_verdicts.py, test_custom_harness_integrity.py) so verdict recording stays correct. Reproduce first; add a harness test (indigo_test/unit/test_harness_verdicts.py or similar) for a filtered parallel-runner suite.
